data.title: 芙莉莲 · 公园长椅
data.description: 【芙莉莲 · 公园长椅】午后暖阳透过绿荫洒在公园的木质长椅上，芙莉莲将法杖抱在怀里，脑袋一点一点地打着瞌睡，白发在微风中轻轻摇曳。她半睁开睡眼迷蒙的眼睛——「唔……别摇我。早上起太早了，菲伦又不在……就让我再睡一小会儿嘛。」
data.promptProse: Frieren dozes on the wooden park bench, both arms loosely holding her staff across her lap as her green eyes briefly open halfway. Her soft casual dress gathers over the seated pose, silver-white twintails resting along the bench back. The medium view places dense summer leaves overhead and the path beyond. Dappled afternoon sun touches the staff and sleeve, while leaf shadows settle across her resting hands.
